en: The image is a black and white postcard divided into three horizontal sections. The top section shows an overview of a rural village with traditional German half-timbered houses and farm buildings. The middle section features a building labeled as the 'Postamt' (post office), with the words 'KAISERLICHES POSTAMT' (Imperial Post Office) on the facade. The bottom section displays a church ('Kirche') with a tall tower and some more traditional buildings nearby. The text is in German.
